checks.questionEn: Before changing the material ratio, predict what stays continuous
checks.questionZh: 改变材料比之前，先预测哪个量连续
checks.answerEn: At right conductivity two, integrating q_x=1 and applying both exterior temperatures gives q=x+11/12. The joint temperature is5/12 and common flux17/12. Left and right slopes are minus17/12 and minus17/24: temperature and flux remain continuous, but slopes differ by the conductivity ratio. These are analytic predictions; the finite-penalty neural runs must still report their actual deviations.
checks.answerZh: 右导热系数为二时，对 q x 等于一积分，并应用两端温度，可得 q 等于 x 加十二分之十一。接口温度为十二分之五，共同通量为十二分之十七。左右斜率分别为负十二分之十七与负二十四分之十七：温度与通量连续，但斜率按导热系数比不同。这些是解析预测；有限惩罚网络运行仍须报告实际偏差。
